thread:
Alex: Quick q — we're flipping on the new autoswitchover fallback by default for rollouts v2 tomorrow. Need a tiny UX call: how do we present operator overrides + audit so SREs don't get flooded?
Maya: +1 on the heads-up. Two things: (1) default sampling for audit events; (2) a clear visible state in the rollout timeline.
Sam: For audit sampling, can we use progressive sampling so early in a rollout we sample more (10%) then decay to 1%? avoids noise.
Jordan: Love progressive sampling. Also we should expose the concrete reason for fallback in the UI — e.g. `latency_95` vs `model_error` vs `quota_exhaust`.
Li: If we expose reasons we need to standardize the metric names. current telemetry has `fallback_code` and `err_class` which are muddy. propose `fallback_reason` + `degrade_mode`.
Alex: Agree on names. Can we show a compact badge on the rollout card with mode + reason? like: `soft-degrade · latency_95` clickable expands sample traces.
Maya: That works. Also operators need a quick escape: a one-click "snooze autoswitch" for 15m/1h and a persistent "stick override" with audit note required.
Sam: UX nit: place snooze on the rollout header, stick override in the operator panel with a required comment. Stick override should create an audit event 100% of the time.
Jordan: Telemetry suggestion: store the override metadata on the decision event: {operator: "name", type: "snooze|stick", TTL: 3600, note: "..."} so we can replay.
Li: +1. Also we should log prior routing policy id and the fallback variant id for reproducibility.
Alex: Example config snippet we discussed for the console docs:
```
policy:
  mode: soft-degrade
  triggers: [latency_95, error_rate]
  sample_rate: 0.1 # initial
  decay_to: 0.01
  operator_notify: true
  audit_on_override: true
```
Maya: Nice. One more thing — what about canary handback oscillation? if an operator keeps flipping stick overrides, we should surface a warning or a cooldown.
Sam: Implement cooldown with exponential backoff per-rollout: 0s -> 5m -> 20m -> 1h and record it in the audit trace.
Jordan: For the display, show a small history line: `overrides: 3 (last: Maya 12m ago, cooldown: 5m)` so ops can see pattern.
Li: For queries, here's a quick KQL to get fallback reasons and overrides for a rollout: `index=redwood_rollouts | where rollout_id=\"<id>\" | stats count() by fallback_reason, override_type`
deploy-bot: Deploy tracker: canary rollout v2-autoswitch started by @Alex at 1763141620 — monitoring channels have been notified.
Alex: thanks. Action items: Maya to mock the badge + override flows, Sam to spec sampling decay, Li to standardize telemetry names and add rollout query examples. Jordan to add cooldown logic to the operator service. I'll merge the console PR after mocks.
Maya: I'll put a quick Figma prototype in #design by EOD.
Sam: I'll drop the sampling doc in the PR — will include numbers.
Li: I'll update telemetry schema and add migration notes.
Jordan: I'll open an infra ticket for cooldown enforcement and link here.
Alex: Great — if anyone thinks we should change the default postpone the flip until we have the mocks, speak now. otherwise we go tomorrow. :+1:
